STRONG STRATEGIC DELIVERY
✅ What Management Did Right (Operational Wins)
  • Prediction Market Leadership: Scaled Event Contracts over 6x YoY to $173M in Q3, turning prediction markets into Robinhood's fastest-growing trading cylinder.
  • Expense Guidance Discipline: Lowered the top end of full-year 2026 Adjusted OpEx & SBC guidance by $25M ($2.675B–$2.750B), demonstrating clear operating leverage.
  • Massive Cash & FCF Generation: Delivered record $1,225M OCF and $1,124M True FCF, expanding total cash and segregated assets to $14.75B.
  • High-Net-Worth Traction: Added $16B in Q3 Net Deposits and announced October MTD deposits already exceeded $13B, including $6B from the Dell family to Trump Accounts.
⚠️ What Management Got Wrong (Execution Drags)
  • Cryptocurrency Volume Contraction: Crypto transaction revenues fell -55% YoY to $120M (vs $268M in Q3 2025), reflecting market-wide spot retail trading fatigue.
  • Headline GAAP EPS Confusion: A $67M (-$0.07/sh) non-cash mark-to-market loss on Robinhood Ventures Fund I caused headline GAAP EPS ($0.51) to optically miss Street consensus ($0.55).
  • Net Interest Income Headwind: Net interest revenue fell -9% YoY to $415M due to lower securities lending activity and lower short-term benchmark rates.
  • Post-Earnings Price Softness: The stock dropped -7.64% after-hours to $87.34 on fast-money profit taking following a +158% year-to-date run-up.

Earnings Conference Call Forensic Highlights: Top 3 Analyst Questions & Answers (Analyst Q&A)

Devin Ryan (Citizens JMP) • Topic: Event Contracts Explosion (>6x YoY to $173M) & Post-Election Longevity

Analyst Question: "Vlad, event contracts surged over 6x YoY to $173M this quarter. How much of this volume is tied to the upcoming U.S. Presidential election versus permanent macro and single-stock event contracts, and what does the post-election decay curve look like?"

Executive Response: "CEO Vlad Tenev emphasized that while the U.S. election is driving peak engagement, Robinhood has rapidly expanded event contracts into economic data releases (CPI, Fed rate cuts), sports outcomes, and quarterly earnings prints. The platform is seeing 65% of event traders cross-trade equities and options, transforming prediction markets into a sticky top-of-funnel customer acquisition channel that continues well past the election cycle."

Dan Dolev (Mizuho Securities) • Topic: Cryptocurrency Revenue Decline (-55% YoY) vs Multi-Asset Diversification

Analyst Question: "Shiv, crypto transaction revenue declined to $120M from $268M last year and $134M in Q1. Given the broader crypto market backdrop, how should we think about crypto's contribution to total revenue going forward?"

Executive Response: "CFO Shiv Verma explained that Robinhood's multi-cylinder strategy is designed precisely to absorb crypto cyclicality. Despite crypto revenue softening -55% YoY, total net revenue reached an all-time record $1,424M because Options (+31% YoY to $399M), Event Contracts (up >6x to $173M), and Equities (+41% YoY to $121M) more than offset the drop. Robinhood is now running 14 business lines at $100M+ annualized revenue, insulating margins."

Brennan Hawken (UBS) • Topic: October Net Deposits Surging Past $13B & Wealth Management Strategy

Analyst Question: "You disclosed that October Net Deposits have already topped $13 billion month-to-date, including $6 billion from the Dell family into Trump Accounts. What does this mean for your average account size, margin lending demand, and long-term net interest income?"

Executive Response: "Vlad Tenev noted that the Dell family contribution marks Robinhood's emergence as a premier platform for high-net-worth wealth preservation. Bringing massive institutional deposits into Trump Accounts significantly lowers Robinhood's effective cost of capital, drives premium Gold subscription uptake, and creates a large, sticky pool of interest-earning assets that will support net interest revenue even in a declining Fed funds rate environment."
